# Canaan Travel Hub

> Kodaikanal tour packages and digital travel services from Tamil Nadu, India.

## What we offer

- **Kodaikanal packages**: Escape, Family, Honeymoon, Luxury, Adventure, and Complete hill-station itineraries (2–6 nights, from INR 12,999).
- **Digital travel services**: Flight booking assistance, hotel stays, visa guidance, and custom tour planning around your Kodai trip.
- **Languages**: English, Tamil (ta), Hindi (hi) at https://canaantravelhub.com/en, /ta, /hi.
